kappa.label: kappa
kappa.role: odd central element of the inhomogeneous extension A = V + C K + C kappa; carries the deformation (Schema 2). Not a basis element of g; first in PBW order.

K.label: K
K.relation: [K, X} = 0 for all X; identified with the scalar 1
K.role: even central element (constant term of oscillator words). Excluded from basis lists; appears as a bracket target label only in Schemas 2-4 when a constant term arises.

inhomogeneous_deformation.description: Inhomogeneous deformation of C(n+1): the fermion-boson exchange relations acquire an odd central term kappa (docs/math/C_inhomogeneous_definition.md).

gb_matrix.parity_note: The deformation term gb*kappa is odd (kappa carries the odd parity); gb values are treated as scalar (c-number) coefficients in all computations, following the pre-oscillator form (b|a) in C_inhomogeneous_definition.md.

gamma_convention.target: g + C K  (entries with Z = 'K' are constant terms of the symmetrized-quadratic realization)
gamma_convention.pairs: all ordered pairs (X, Y) with non-zero gamma
gamma_convention.coeff_encoding: linear form {gb parameter: rational}; gamma is homogeneous linear in gb

references: Frappat, Sciarrino, Sorba (2000), Dictionary on Lie Algebras and Superalgebras, arXiv:hep-th/9607161
